headline: Peru Extends S/ 2 Billion Credit Repayment Relief for Small Businesses Under El Niño
summary: Peru's Ministry of Economy and Finance activated S/ 2,000 million in guarantees and authorized up to 12-month debt rescheduling under Impulso Myperú to support businesses impacted by El Niño.
why: State-backed guarantee programs protect liquidity for micro and small enterprises against severe climatic shocks in Peru.
